answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 21858 Country: Pakistan Title: I have a son whos name is MUHAMMAD TALAL please told me whether this name is good or not? Question: I have a son whos name is MUHAMMAD TALAL please told me whether this name is good or not? Answer ID: 21858 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 844/668/B=1431) Tilal ( طلال ) is the plural of tallu ( طلّ ), it means: dew, wetness, dampness, charming, interesting, of one advanced age. It is good name, you can keep it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
